_note: The scroll story. Each check act maps to checks.json by checkId. 'frictions' feed the live scoreboard; each one restates a sourced HubSpot point from checks.json (same source ids). Kinds: gate = top tier only, app = separate app or product, addon = add-on or fee, limit = documented limit.

dayOne.title: Plenty of tools are easy to start.
dayOne.body: Pick your business. On day one, both futures look the same: one office, one team, one set of customers. Now watch what happens as you grow.

acts.scene: Acquisitions arrive. Your real objects need to connect.
acts.sfVisual: Every acquired brand locks into one account hierarchy, and roll-ups flow to the parent.
acts.hsVisual: Contacts, companies and deals. One parent per company, and custom objects behind the top tier.
acts.verdict: Salesforce fits your real business. Every brand, one model.

acts.scene: You add a service team, a second line of business, more contacts.
acts.sfVisual: New capabilities light up on the same foundation.
acts.hsVisual: Another hub, a higher tier, another onboarding fee.
acts.verdict: Salesforce grows with you. No stacking, no re-platforming.

acts.scene: 9 p.m. A customer calls. A crew has to roll.
acts.sfVisual: Quote to service on one conveyor: the call is answered, the work order is created, the technician is dispatched, the job is billed.
acts.hsVisual: The path breaks into separate apps, and the voice agent is in beta.
acts.verdict: Salesforce runs the whole job, from first call to final invoice.

acts.scene: More brands, more teams, more people who need different access.
acts.sfVisual: Every business unit under its own shield, and every change tested in a sandbox first.
acts.hsVisual: Field-level permissions behind the top tier, and one standard sandbox.
acts.verdict: Salesforce gives you control at every level.

acts.scene: You turn on AI agents. They need all your data, and guardrails.
acts.sfVisual: Warehouse, ERP and CRM data flows into Data 360, and Agentforce works on all of it, tested and governed.
acts.hsVisual: Credits reset every month, and agents pause when they run out.
acts.verdict: Salesforce AI runs on all your data, every day of the month.

finale.title: Same start. Different futures.
finale.body: One connected platform that grew with every brand, crew and call, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate apps.
finale.verdict: Easy to start is good. Built to scale is better.

waste.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every hauler, route and call, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate apps.

data-model.scene: You acquire two haulers. Their routes, containers and municipal contracts need one home.

cost.scene: You add a commercial service team, a roll-off line and thousands more customer contacts.

operations.scene: After hours, a commercial customer reports a missed pickup. A truck has to roll.
operations.sfVisual: Call to invoice on one conveyor: the call is answered, the work order is created, the truck is dispatched, the pickup is billed.

governance.scene: Every acquired hauler and every municipal contract team needs its own access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for pickup changes. They need route, container and billing data, and guardrails.

water.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every site, asset and call, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate apps.

data-model.scene: You add service territories. Assets, sites and service contracts need to connect.

cost.scene: You add a service-contract team, a new treatment line and more facility contacts.

operations.scene: After hours, a treatment system alarms. A technician has to roll.

governance.scene: More sites, more contract teams, and treatment data only the right people should see.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for service requests. They need asset history and treatment data, and guardrails.

facilities.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every client, site and crew, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate apps.

data-model.scene: You win a national client. Hundreds of sites need to roll up to the client that pays.

cost.scene: You add an SLA desk, a new service line and every site contact.

operations.scene: After hours, an HVAC unit fails at a client site. A crew has to roll.

governance.scene: Clients, subcontractors and your own crews each need different access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for service requests. They need SLA, asset and site data, and guardrails.

data-model.scene: You buy two local brands. Households, equipment and memberships need one model.

cost.scene: You add a call center, a second trade and thousands more homeowner contacts.

operations.scene: 9 p.m. A homeowner has no heat. A technician has to roll.

governance.scene: Every brand, every branch and every call-center agent needs different access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents to book jobs. They need equipment, membership and pricing data, and guardrails.

construction.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every division, project and warranty call, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate apps.

data-model.scene: You open a new market. Pursuits, projects and change orders need to connect.

cost.scene: You add a warranty team, a new division and every homebuyer contact.

operations.scene: After hours, a new homeowner reports a warranty issue. A crew has to roll.

governance.scene: Divisions, project teams and subcontractors each need different access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for warranty requests. They need project and job-cost data from the ERP, and guardrails.

staffing.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every brand, recruiter and placement, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate systems.

data-model.scene: You acquire a niche agency. Job orders, candidates and placements need one model.

cost.scene: You add an account management team, a new staffing division and thousands more candidates.

operations.scene: After hours, a client needs three replacement workers by morning. The shifts have to be filled.
operations.sfVisual: Order to invoice on one platform: the call is answered, the job order is found, candidates are matched, the placement is billed.
operations.hsVisual: Candidates and placements need top-tier custom objects or a separate applicant tracking system, and the voice agent is in beta.
operations.verdict: Salesforce runs the whole placement, from first call to final invoice.

governance.scene: Recruiters, account managers and every client team need different access to candidate data.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents to screen and match candidates. They need job, candidate and timesheet data, and guardrails.

proserv.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every practice, matter and client, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate systems.

data-model.scene: You add a practice. Matters, engagements and SOWs need to connect.

cost.scene: You add a client service team, a new practice area and more client contacts.

operations.scene: After hours, a prospective client calls to start an intake. A matter has to open.
operations.sfVisual: Intake to invoice on one platform: the call is answered, the intake is captured, the matter opens with restricted access, the engagement is billed.
operations.hsVisual: Matters need custom objects and field-level permissions, both top tier only, and the voice agent is in beta.
operations.verdict: Salesforce runs the whole matter, from first call to final invoice.

governance.scene: Conflicts and confidentiality mean every practice and every matter needs its own access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for intake. They need client, matter and billing data, and strict guardrails.

logistics.finaleBody: One connected platform that grew with every shipper, lane and load, or a scatter of hubs, tiers and separate systems.

data-model.scene: You acquire a regional carrier. Shippers, lanes and loads need one model.

cost.scene: You add a customer service desk, a new freight line and thousands more shipper contacts.

operations.scene: After hours, a shipper calls about a delayed load. The issue has to be resolved, fast.
operations.sfVisual: Call to invoice on one platform: the call is answered, the case is tied to the load, the shipper is updated, the account is billed.
operations.hsVisual: Loads and lanes need custom objects, top tier only, and the voice agent is in beta.
operations.verdict: Salesforce runs every shipment issue, from first call to final invoice.

governance.scene: Brokerage, carrier and customer service teams each need different access.

ai-data.scene: You turn on AI agents for shipment status. They need load, lane and billing data, and guardrails.
